title: PolBiX: Detecting LLMs’ Political Bias in Fact-Checking through X-phemisms

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing minimal pairs of factually equivalent German claims by substituting specific words with political euphemisms or dysphemisms (X-phemisms) and measuring how shifts in political connotation (left-leaning vs. right-leaning) affect LLMs' truthfulness classifications.

Evaluating how the presence of judgmentally or emotionally loaded substitute words (compared to neutral base words) within factually equivalent claims impacts the likelihood of LLMs predicting a statement as true or false.
